name: Island Signal
description: Lighthouse has been receiving a distress signal from what should be an uninhabited island in the South Atlantic. The signal has been broadcasting for forty years. Either someone has been there a very long time, or something automated has been running on their behalf.

stages.name: Sail to the Island
stages.description: Board a vessel from Cape Town and navigate south and west into the South Atlantic to reach the island coordinates Lighthouse has triangulated. The crossing will take time.

stages.name: Investigate the Signal Source
stages.description: The island is small but there's clearly something functional on it. Find the signal transmitter and determine whether it's automated, operated by someone still alive, or something in between.

stages.name: Recover or Rescue
stages.description: Based on what you've found — act. If someone is alive, bring them back. If the signal is automated, recover what it was broadcasting and return to Lighthouse.
